observations: A custom-painted motorcycle with blue, black, and yellow color scheme.

The engine is visible and appears to be a single-cylinder air-cooled unit, with a white engine cover and a Captain America-style decal on the side.

The seat is black with 'J-Nice' and 'The Real' written in gold script.
The rear fender has 'Incredible' written on it with a cartoon character.
The tires are standard, with red trim on the front rim.
The bike is parked on dirt ground, with a concrete wall in the background.
No visible brand or model name on any part of the motorcycle in the photos.
